tooltip.jaymospowers.clinging_coil: It holds on. Under water, once, it lets go instead of you
jei.jaymospowers.clinging_coil: Worn in the charm slot. If you would die under water, of drowning or of anything else, the coil is used up instead: you are left alive with a full breath, half a minute of water breathing and a shove toward the surface. It is cut from something that lies under a few of the treasure wrecks.
jei.jaymospowers.deep_tooth: A hooked tooth as long as a hand, from the arms of something that lies under a few of the treasure wrecks. Shape it at the Part Builder like bone: iron-tier heads and arrowheads that hit harder on anything in water.
